headline: 18 Enzyme contracts catalogued across Ethereum (core + token), Arbitrum, and Polygon; governance via Enzyme Council; full address lists for Polygon/Arbitrum and Onyx deployments require further fetching.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan name-tag search surfaced 8 Ethereum addresses with 'Enzyme Finance' tags: Dispatcher (0xC3DC853dD716bd5754f421ef94fdCbac3902ab32), Fund Deployer 2 (0x4f1c53f096533c04d8157efb6bca3eb22ddc6360), Address List Registry (0x4eb4c7babfb5d54ab4857265b482fb6512d22dff), MLN Token (0xec67005c4e498ec7f55e092bd1d35cbc47c91892), Fund Actions Wrapper (0xbc9a63cad5a825bd5854abca4f3d42d6acf9bffa), Deposit Wrapper (0x59ea865ebb903ebc3e345efbbd4206dbd20d9c3f), Vault Lib (0x1b3694907ed7459c7b0116e7c6a4b7788288577f), Management Fee 2 (0xfaf2c3db614e9d38fe05edc634848be7ff0542b9), Allowed Assets For Redemption (0x823ca839da344da59d517b84ce3bab9ffc9f54ee). Block explorers for Polygon (polygonscan.com) and Arbitrum (arbiscan.io) not directly fetched this run.

D2: docs.enzyme.finance/developer-hub identifies two deployed-contracts pages: https://docs.enzyme.finance/onyx-protocol/contract-addresses (Enzyme Onyx) and https://github.com/enzymefinance/sdk/tree/main/packages/environment/src/deployments (Enzyme Blue/v4). The legacy v4 docs at docs.enzyme.finance/general-info/codebase/contracts/mainnet returned 404 but the contract name list was surfaced via search snippet (Dispatcher, FundDeployer, FundValueCalculator, GlobalConfigProxy, IntegrationManager, ExternalPositionFactory, GasRelayPaymasterFactory, etc.).

D3: audit.enzyme.finance returned an access-denied error. docs.enzyme.finance/developer-hub links to two audit repos: https://github.com/enzymefinance/protocol-onyx/tree/main/audits (Onyx) and https://github.com/enzymefinance/protocol/tree/dev/audits (Blue/v4). GitHub was also blocked. No audit PDFs fetched this run; specific firm names and dates not confirmed on-chain.

D4: GitHub org enzymefinance identified from protocol.github. Two relevant repos surfaced: enzymefinance/sdk (SDK + Blue deployment artifacts at packages/environment/src/deployments) and enzymefinance/protocol-onyx (Onyx protocol + audits). GitHub direct fetch was blocked; no pinned commit SHA obtained this run. Onyx contract addresses page at docs.enzyme.finance/onyx-protocol/contract-addresses not fetched.

D5: Polygon — docs.enzyme.finance/general-info/codebase/contracts/polygon search snippet confirmed contract names exist (AaveV2Adapter, AaveV3Adapter, AddressListRegistry, FundDeployer, etc.) but addresses were not present in the snippet; page returned 404 on direct fetch. Arbitrum — docs.enzyme.finance/general-info/codebase/contracts/arbitrum search snippet surfaced partial addresses: AaveV3Adapter 0xd0c6b9801fc1e70945f11b3f93340dcc7507fd7c, AaveV3ATokenListOwner 0x575af64231a91b3a954d5e45a57187ace6549c81, AaveV3DebtPositionLib 0x5fe2db5abbb9fd2f840a51916abbda451151e56f, AaveV3DebtPositionParser 0xa4fc3fa736b812ee086c75c442d568a2cd48cd59, AaveV3FlashLoanAssetManagerFactory 0xb49f8c0ce9df900e024dab48952bb8a8992c1795, AaveV3FlashLoanAssetManagerLib 0xd38c8c77b250d80e743013c4019d02f6cc85b80e. Core infra addresses (Dispatcher, FundDeployer) for Arbitrum and Polygon not yet confirmed.

D6: FundDeployer (0x4f1c53f096533c04d8157efb6bca3eb22ddc6360) is the factory for VaultProxy/ComptrollerProxy instances. sdk.enzyme.finance confirms thousands of individual vault instances exist; capped per instructions. Factory address recorded; child enumeration deferred to dedicated ingestion run.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: Dispatcher = admin (top-level release linker); FundDeployer = factory (vault factory per release); AddressListRegistry = other; MLN = token; VaultLib = other; GasRelayPaymasterFactory = factory; FundActionsWrapper = router; DepositWrapper = router; ManagementFee2 = other. Enzyme Council governs the Dispatcher/protocol ownership; Council is composed of Enzyme Technical Council (ETC) 5 members and Enzyme User Representatives (EUR) 2 members.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] are sourced from Etherscan search result snippets with Enzyme Finance name-tag (Ethereum) or from docs.enzyme.finance search snippet (Arbitrum). Polygon core addresses not surfaced with verified on-chain citations this run — recorded in unknowns[].

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked enzyme.finance, docs.enzyme.finance/developer-hub, Etherscan name-tag search results, and search snippets from docs.enzyme.finance contract pages. 18 contracts catalogued: 9 Ethereum core/peripheral (Dispatcher, FundDeployer, AddressListRegistry, MLN token, VaultLib, ManagementFee2, FundActionsWrapper, DepositWrapper, AllowedAssetsForRedemption), 6 Arbitrum adapter contracts from search snippet, and 3 additional (FundValueCalculator, GlobalConfigProxy, IntegrationManager named but not addressed this run). audit.enzyme.finance and GitHub were blocked; Polygon addresses not confirmed on-chain.

protocol_metadata.about: Enzyme Finance is a decentralized on-chain asset management protocol that allows users to create, manage, and invest in tokenized vaults (funds) holding diverse DeFi assets. Managers deposit assets into VaultProxy contracts and interact with 30+ DeFi protocols via built-in adapters (Aave, Uniswap, Curve, etc.) controlled by a ComptrollerProxy. The protocol offers three product lines: Enzyme Blue (decentralized strategy management), Enzyme Onyx (institutional vault-as-a-service for tokenized funds), and Enzyme Myso (on-chain options). Governance is handled by the Enzyme Council — a DAO composed of the Enzyme Technical Council (5 members) and Enzyme User Representatives (2 members) — with the MLN ERC-20 token used for payments and governance participation.
